notes.title: Experiment Build for Everyone
notes.content:
We would like to announce a something about Blue Bird.

We Make an Experiment Build on Steam Blue Bird Branch.

And you free to test it. Yes. 100% free to test some feature we working on it.

Also, We would like to hear you feedback/report too.

How to got this?
- Open Beta Tab on Blue Bird and Set it to "experiment"
and redownload a game.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11958869/d88cb272fe722593b70f0ce65f5845fe05719a67.png[/img]


This first Experiment Changelog here.
- Convert png > webp.
- English Dialogue Fix Patch
- Fix UI on Some Scene (Still, fix it)

TODO
- Plot Hole Fix.
- New CG Cinema Mode
- CG Gallery 
- New Character Work

If you ask for EP3-5. Here is our answer.
- We not going to push any EP3-5 in Experiment Build before we finish it first. But Who brought Preorder will be Play EP3-5 in Tester Build.

Fair Enough?

Thank you for support Blue Bird.

- Fix UI on Some Scene (Still, fix it)

notes.title: -10% Discount Steam Summer Sale And A lot of things I didn't announcement yet.
notes.content:
Sorry for a long gone. My university Start and I change working time from "Full-Time" to "Hobby" (like 3-5 hour per day)

First
 - After 2 weeks of Start and I registered a "Mobile Apps Development Class" and got a project to work. That why I start porting Blue Bird to Mobile Devices ex. Android (But iOS didn't port because I didn't have an iPhone and Developer User) Almost Finish but Game still in Alpha Test. Need a lot of time to test on Android Devices

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11958869/f620850415704b145c463f87b8cc893880f0a06c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11958869/06cfda205b99648721432481f32af69e76070b27.png[/img]

After Finish. I'll announcement again.

Next Topic
A lot of people tell me about Game Background.
ex. "Seem Good Seem S*it" or "He just download another work"
So I decided to use Blender, 3D Max, Maya to make a 3D Scene and Render to export to images and put it in Photoshop to do Image processing for better graphic. But it uses a lot of process time to work for "1 Person" But I Try to do as fast as possible. (But I really want someone to help me about this. ;w;)

Next
Let's talk about EP 3,4,5 and Version 18+ 1-5

After Blue Bird Release on Steam And I got to step up to do a writer job.
Also, I almost finish EP3 (and write some plot story for 4-5 already) And nearly send a Thai Story to English Translator to translate a game and CG for another EP too.


Big Update I have to apologize here. For late then I though because of Game, Making New CG, New Steam Trade Cards, Drama CD DLC too.



I (KimoiEngineGuy) like to say "Thank you very much for the support and Help for report a bug, mistake, mispronounced. I will get all these feedback to make a game better.

Thank you from bottom of my heart.

And Also 
Steam Summer Sale I make a discount -10% For fair to who miss a "Discount Launch"

Have Fun.

[spoiler][quote=KimoiEngineGuy]
Oh. I forgot to tell you about this. Did someone Unlock Achievement "RIP"? 
I investigate it who did this and I want to tell you here.

Achievement "RIP" = Achievement Cheater Detect ːB1ː [/quote][/spoiler]

Achievement "RIP" = Achievement Cheater Detect ːB1ː

notes.title: New Update and Prerelease version
notes.content:
For the next week. (if the game did not get any major bug)
Who Pre-order will play chapter 1-2 for 1 weeks and it's only in the Thai language

Unfortunately, The English language. Have to wait for the next week... (After Prerelease of Thai version released)

And in chapter 1-2, this game is not yet a complete.

 In Chapter 3 and Chapter "4-5" will change the image CG, BG ('Cause Low budget), and the system in the game might be better.

Also Steam Cloud May not be available for chapter 1-2.
But there's some achievement done (for 1-2)

And Steam Trade card will come at Chapter 3 or maybe "the last chapter".

For Streaming / Youtuber allowed to play only chapter 1-2 first.
Next chapter. We not sure about this yet.

Hope everyone going to get the game at cheap price soon. 

It's mind took a lot of time to finish make this game.


ps. I got a Final Exam at 14/2 and 24/2, maybe it takes more time.

Thank you.
KimoiEngineGuy
